ModMetaData.name: Ken's Mod
ModMetaData.author: Ken
ModMetaData.description:
Adds herbal teas to RimWorld. Grow tea herbs, dry the harvested leaves on a drying rack (2 days), then brew them at a campfire or stove.

Fresh leaves rot in about two weeks; dried leaves keep indefinitely. Rain pauses drying outdoors.

Teas:
 - Chamomile tea: calms pawns for a few hours (+6 mood, lower mental break threshold).
 - Peppermint tea: refreshing (+3 mood) and cuts food poisoning short.
 - Ginger tea: warms the body, so pawns tolerate 8°C more cold for about 8 hours.

Build a teapot in your rec or dining room, pick a tea, and haulers keep it filled with up to 50 cups. Colonists drink from it for recreation and bond over shared tea.
